request.intent: A relaxed Sunday morning plan in Lisbon on Nov 15, back at Casa Lumeira by 16:00

files.name: App.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Canvas, Page } from 'design';
  import Flight from './lib/Flight.svelte';
  import Stay from './lib/Stay.svelte';
  import SaturdayPlan from './lib/SaturdayPlan.svelte';
  import Costs from './lib/Costs.svelte';
  import Packing from './lib/Packing.svelte';
</script>

<Canvas>
  <Page title="Lisbon Weekend" lede="Fly in Friday morning, stay two nights in Alfama, spend Saturday on markets, trams and the river at Belém, and fly home Sunday evening.">
    <Flight />
    <Stay />
    <SaturdayPlan />
    <Costs />
    <Packing />
  </Page>
</Canvas>

files.name: lib/Flight.svelte
files.contents:
Return, one cabin bag included Airport to Alfama by metro, about 30 min

€212

{#snippet actions()} (booked = true)} /> ask('Getting from Lisbon airport to Alfama on Friday morning: metro route and transfer options', 'Airport transfer')} /> {/snippet}

files.name: lib/Stay.svelte
files.contents:
A small guesthouse with a roof terrace over the river, a 5-minute walk from the Tram 28 stop.

Rua das Pedras Altas 14, Alfama Check-in Fri from 14:00 · bags held from 10:30 Check-out Sun by 11:00

€256 · 2 nights × €128

{#snippet actions()} (reserved = true)} /> ask('Other places to stay in Lisbon for Nov 13–15, 2 nights, around €130 a night', 'Other stays')} /> {/snippet}

files.contents:
{#each stops as stop, i} (current = i)} /> {/each}

files.name: lib/Costs.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Summary } from 'design';

  const rows = [
    { label: 'Flight, return', value: '€212' },
    { label: 'Casa Lumeira, 2 nights', value: '€256' },
    { label: 'Metro and trams, about', value: '€16' },
    { label: 'Food and fado', value: '€140' }
  ];
</script>

<Section title="Costs" kicker="Budget · 1 traveller">
  <Summary {rows} total={{ label: 'Weekend total', value: '€624' }} />
</Section>

files.name: lib/Packing.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Checklist } from 'design';

  const items = [
    'Passport',
    'Boarding passes',
    'Comfortable shoes for the hills',
    'Light rain jacket',
    'Euro card or some cash for trams',
    'Phone charger and plug adapter'
  ];
</script>

<Section title="What to Pack" kicker="Cabin bag only">
  <Checklist {items} />
</Section>
